name: General Radiance Field Rendering via MLP
aliases: Geometry and Radiance Field Network Architecture
MLP Radiance Field with Aggregated Features
definition: An MLP predicts RGB values and volumetric density for a 3D point using its aggregated feature vector and viewing direction, forming a general radiance field.
summary: General Radiance Field Rendering via MLP renders novel views by training an MLP to predict density and color using aggregated 3D point features instead of raw coordinates.
